2. **Two cards separated by a single space leave the first in the clear** — `4111111111111111 4111111111111111` → `4111111111111111 [CARD]`. This follows directly from two spec rules (a single space is part of the number; a 20+ digit run is never a card), but it is an under-redaction. Pinned by a test so it can't drift silently.

3. **The permission-denied test adapts instead of skipping** — this environment runs as uid 0, which bypasses file permission bits, so `chmod 000` does not produce `EACCES`. Since the constitution forbids skipped tests, that test asserts the FR-021 failure contract when the file is genuinely unreadable and the FR-023 success contract when it isn't. I added an unconditional `ENAMETOOLONG` case so the open-time `OSError` path is still exercised as root.
